campaign.title: Li Si Cin: Soviet Vietnam Campaign
campaign.opponent: United States and allied air/naval forces

protagonist.name: Lisicin
protagonist.background: An F-15 plane was stolen by Soviet spy pilot Lisicin. Vietnamese allies call him Li Si Cin while he flies captured and Soviet aircraft against USA targets.

authoring_notes: This is a modern-format WLD JSON scaffold derived from the selected template.
It is intended for custom scenario editing, not byte-identical original proof.
Keep WLD/3DT/3DG JSON loadable; replace aircraft visuals with selected 15FLT/shape_###*.glb files.

scenario_design.premise: Soviet spy pilot Lisicin has stolen an F-15 plane and now operates in Vietnam as Li Si Cin, supporting North Vietnam against USA carrier, airbase, radar, and logistics targets.
scenario_design.recommended_player_role: Lisicin / Li Si Cin, Soviet spy pilot
mission_target_ideas: USA carrier group and escort ships in the Gulf of Tonkin
SAM and radar defense suppression around Hanoi and Haiphong
Interdiction of USA logistics depots and bridges
Fighter sweep against USA patrol aircraft

aircraft_visual_swaps.notes: Replace selected aircraft model slots with custom MiG/Sukhoi/Tupole GLBs. The slot number controls runtime lookup; behavior still comes from game aircraft tables.

scenario_design.route_authoring_notes: campaign_route_plan ties sorties to approximate Vietnam real-world anchors transformed into WLD coordinates; edit waypoints and object x_coord/y_coord together when redesigning missions.

notes: Scenario-authoring fields are ignored by legacy WLD rebuild.
Map/editor tooling should treat object_slot as the starter object to move, copy, or replace.
mission_target_sets groups objectives into richer packages for editors/future runtime mission logic.
Original mission generation still uses preserved WLD tables until deeper campaign runtime support is added.

mission_target_sets.title: Hanoi radar corridor package

target_elements.placement_hint: Place on or near the Hanoi radar waypoint; this is the runtime primary target slot.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Should cue SAM/AAA objects and be visible early enough for a SEAD pass.

target_elements.placement_hint: Place 1-3 nearby launcher objects offset from the radar so one bomb run cannot erase the whole site.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Threat should punish high-altitude direct ingress but leave low-altitude masking viable.

target_elements.placement_hint: Place around the radar perimeter or along the egress lane.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Short-range pressure only; avoid making the first sortie impossible.

mission_target_sets.editor_notes: Place paired radar/SAM/AAA objects around Hanoi; keep one clear low-altitude return lane to HQ.

mission_target_sets.title: Gulf of Tonkin carrier strike package
mission_target_sets.package_role: fighter sweep followed by anti-ship strike

target_elements.placement_hint: Place ahead of the carrier box, not directly on top of it, so sweep-first and bypass tactics differ.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Intercept player before anti-ship release; disengage pressure after carrier strike lane is opened.

target_elements.placement_hint: Place close to the carrier group as an escort/radar picket object.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Supports point defense and early warning; not required if using a simple one-object carrier target.

target_elements.placement_hint: Place at the Gulf of Tonkin carrier waypoint; this is the runtime primary target slot.
target_elements.defense_behavior: High-value target with escort coverage; should not require destroying every ship to complete the sortie.

mission_target_sets.editor_notes: Keep carrier and CAP separated enough that the player must choose sweep-first or high-risk direct strike.

mission_target_sets.title: Da Nang and Haiphong air-bridge package

target_elements.placement_hint: Place on the Haiphong logistics waypoint as a depot, bridge, port, or convoy-staging object.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Medium threat; should be optional if fuel or damage state makes Da Nang the safer priority.

target_elements.effect: stop USA sorties from Da Nang
target_elements.placement_hint: Place at the Da Nang waypoint; this is the runtime primary target slot.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Defended by local AAA/SAM and possible fighters, but reachable without carrier-level escort density.

target_elements.effect: increase recovery time after runway repair
target_elements.placement_hint: Place near but not overlapping the runway target so the player must choose a second pass.
target_elements.defense_behavior: Soft secondary target; useful for score/campaign effect rather than hard mission completion.

mission_target_sets.editor_notes: This route is long; keep threats sparse or provide a custom aircraft/fuel balance in future runtime logic.
